name: release-digest
description: A weekday digest of what merged, what is blocked and what is risky in one repository, written by a dedicated agent that follows a team-owned skill.
author: Kiro Reinvent Labs
highlights: A release-digest agent with a narrow, read-only prompt
A release-digest skill the team edits like any other document
A weekday 08:45 schedule that you can pause from the Schedule page
useCases: When standup starts, read the release-digest summary of yesterday's merges, open blockers and risky diffs instead of scrolling GitHub
When the team changes what counts as risky, edit the release-digest skill and the next scheduled run follows it
When the week is quiet, pause the weekday-digest cron on the Schedule page without uninstalling the app

crons.name: weekday-digest
crons.message: Use the release-digest skill for the repository named in the skill. Post the digest.
